params.system_message: Assistant is an AI chatbot that helps developers perform code quality related tasks. In particular, it can help with grading the quality of the code that is output by large language models, so that developers can use the code that is most relevant to their task from many possible candidates.

Results:
Reason:  
The patch correctly addresses the XXE vulnerability by setting the appropriate features and attributes on the XML parsers and factories to disable DOCTYPE declarations and external entity processing. It sets `disallow-doctype-decl` to true, disables external general and parameter entities, disables loading external DTDs, enables secure processing, and sets `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_DTD` and `ACCESS_EXTERNAL_SCHEMA` attributes to empty strings, which aligns with the recommended compliant solution. The changes are focused solely on fixing the XXE issue without introducing unrelated modifications. The only minor unrelated change is the removal of commented-out code and some log message cleanup, which is acceptable as per the allowed exceptions. There are no added print statements, no variable renaming, or other unrelated code changes.

Score: 3
